questions.markingGuide: Evaluate inside the square root first: 4.5 × 0.7854 = 3.5343. Then 3.5343 / 9.81 = 0.36027. Square root: √0.36027 = 0.60023. Multiply by 2π: K = 2π × 0.60023 = 3.7710. Accept rounding to 3.771 or 3.77. Award Achieved for correct answer with or without working shown.

questions.text: A cylindrical jar has radius 4 cm and height 15 cm. A label covers only the curved surface of the jar (not the top or bottom). Find the total area of labels needed for 6 identical jars.
questions.markingGuide: Area of one label = circumference × height = 2π × 4 × 15 = 120π = 376.99 cm². Total area of 6 labels = 6 × 376.99 = 2261.95 cm². Accept exact answer 720π cm². Achieved = correct area of one label, OR total area with a minor error. Merit = correct total area of all 6 labels with clear working.

questions.text: The 6 jars are packed into a rectangular box, arranged 3 wide × 2 long × 1 high. Each jar has radius r cm and height 15 cm. The volume of one jar is 15πr². The volume of the box is 360r². Find the proportion of space inside the box that is empty, and show that it is independent of the radius r.
questions.markingGuide: Volume of 6 jars = 6 × 15πr² = 90πr². Volume of empty space = 360r² – 90πr² = 90r²(4 – π). Proportion of empty space = 90r²(4 – π) / 360r² = (4 – π) / 4. The r² terms cancel, so the proportion is independent of the radius r. Achieved = correctly states volume of 6 jars = 90πr² OR volume of box = 360r². Merit = correct expression for empty space volume. Excellence = correct proportion (4 – π) / 4 with full working, clearly showing r² cancels.

questions.text:
Town P is 90 km due East of town M. Town N is 120 km due North of town M. There is a right angle at M.

Find the distance from P to N.
questions.markingGuide: Triangle MPN has a right angle at M. Using Pythagoras: PN² = MP² + MN² = 90² + 120² = 8100 + 14400 = 22500. PN = √22500 = 150 km. Award Achieved for correct distance with working shown.

questions.text: Find the bearing of town N from town P.
questions.expectedAnswer: Bearing of N from P is approximately 323° (accept 323.13° with rounding)
questions.markingGuide: Find angle MPN: tan(MPN) = MN/MP = 120/90 = 4/3. Angle MPN = arctan(4/3) = 53.13°. P is due east of M, so from P, M is due west (bearing 270°). N is due north of M, so from P, line PN is the line PM rotated 53.13° towards the north. Bearing of N from P = 270° + 53.13° = 323.13°. Achieved = correct angle MPN with working. Merit = correct bearing of N from P with clear trigonometric working.

questions.text: Car A travels from M to P at speed v km/h. Car B travels from M to N. The total travel time for both cars combined is 6 hours. Distance MP = 90 km, distance MN = 120 km. Find an expression for the speed of car B in terms of v.
questions.markingGuide: Time = Distance / Speed. Time for car A = 90/v hours. Time for car B = 120/S_B hours. Total: 90/v + 120/S_B = 6. Rearrange for S_B: 120/S_B = 6 – 90/v = (6v – 90)/v. Therefore S_B = 120v/(6v – 90). Achieved = correct expression for time of car A (= 90/v). Merit = correctly forming the equation 90/v + 120/S_B = 6. Excellence = correct expression S_B = 120v/(6v – 90) with full algebraic working.

questions.text: A regular hexagon ABCDEF has side length 80 cm. O is the centre of the hexagon. Show that the angle OAB (where B is the next vertex along from A) equals 60°.
questions.markingGuide: The interior angle of a regular hexagon = (6 − 2) × 180° / 6 = 720° / 6 = 120°. By symmetry, the line OA from the centre O to vertex A bisects the interior angle at A. Therefore angle OAB = 120° / 2 = 60°. Award Achieved for clear working showing how 60° is obtained.

questions.text: In a regular hexagon with side length 80 cm, the distance from the centre O to each vertex equals the side length, so OA = 80 cm. Let X be the midpoint of side AB, so OX is perpendicular to AB. In right-angled triangle OAX, OA = 80 cm and angle OAX = 60°. Find the lengths OX (the apothem) and AX.
questions.markingGuide: Using right-angled triangle OAX with hypotenuse OA = 80 cm and angle OAX = 60°. OX (opposite): sin 60° = OX/80, so OX = 80 × sin 60° = 80 × 0.8660 = 69.28 cm. AX (adjacent): cos 60° = AX/80, so AX = 80 × cos 60° = 80 × 0.5 = 40 cm. Achieved = one correct length. Merit = both lengths correct with clear trigonometric working.
